title: Periodogram
text: Power spectral density or mean-square spectrum estimate using periodogram method, 1 input, 1 output, {Window} sets Window type; {Measurement}, {Beta}, {Window sampling}, {FFT implementation}, {Stopband attenuation in dB}, {Inherit FFT length from input dimensions}, {FFT length} sets the number of data points, {Number of spectral averages}, {Inherit sample time from input} and {Sample time of original time series}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Measurement
params.values: Measurement type Power spectral density (default) | Mean-square spectrum

params.name: Window
params.values: Window type Hamming (default) | Bartlett | Blackman | Boxcar | Chebyshev | Hann | Hanning | Kaiser | Triang

params.name: Inherit FFT length from input dimensions
Inherit sample time from input
params.values: Inherit sample time from input on (default) | off

params.name: Sample time of original time series
params.values: Sample time of original time series 1 (default) | scalar
